_what: Hemodynamic Homeostasis -- emerge nodes from measured gamma, transduce via the sensory layer, circulate the fast/slow setpoint loops, map the interactions, and read fundamental-vs-symptomatic therapy. MAP is owned by no single organ.

calibration._what: [CAL] absolute-scale track: explicit cited anchors propagated through the locked [V] relations and validated against independent references; first-principles derivation stays [O]. Calibration is not derivation.

CO_rest_L_min.source: resting cardiac output, Guyton & Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology

CVP_rest_mmHg.source: resting central venous pressure, Guyton & Hall

GFR_norm_mL_min.source: normal whole-kidney GFR ~120 mL/min, Guyton & Hall

MD_NaCl_op_mM.source: macula-densa luminal NaCl operating point ~30-60 mM (renal physiology)

SVR_rest_WU.source: resting systemic vascular resistance (hybrid/Wood units), Guyton & Hall

baroreceptor_Fmax_Hz.source: peak single-fiber carotid/aortic baroreceptor afferent rate, order ~100 Hz (electrophysiology)

baroreflex_gain.source: arterial baroreflex open-loop gain ~2-4 (classic baroreflex physiology)

perfusion_floor_MAP_mmHg.source: organ-perfusion MAP target >=65 mmHg (Surviving Sepsis Campaign)

calibration.honesty: [CAL] = calibrated (anchor cited + propagated + cross-checked); [O] (first-principles) preserved; residual-open items not forced into a pass

CAL1.kind: consistency calibration (seam constants are clinically inter-dependent)
CAL1.note: the locked hydraulic identity, fed the three cited resting seam constants, fixes the absolute mmHg scale and places all four hemodynamic quantities inside their independent clinical bands at once (SVR at the upper edge); this is calibration/consistency, not derivation -- first-principles absolute mmHg remains [O]
CAL1.title: absolute arterial pressure scale (mmHg)

CAL2.note: the cited open-loop gain G=3 propagates through the closed-loop control law to a 75% buffered fraction and a 5 mmHg steady residual for a 20 mmHg step (CAL1 scale); both sit inside the cited arterial-baroreflex range; absolute latency stays cited [L]
CAL2.title: absolute baroreflex gain + buffered step (mmHg)

CAL3.kind: one anchor -> full curve (operating-point + onset/saturation cross-checked)
CAL3.note: one cited peak-rate anchor (~100 Hz) calibrates the substrate-shaped curve to absolute Hz: the afferent fires ~50 Hz at the resting setpoint (mid-range, reserve in both directions) and saturates ~96 Hz near 170 mmHg, with firing onset ~50 mmHg -- all matching the cited electrophysiology window; the discrete R19 spike code is [V]
CAL3.title: absolute baroreceptor firing rate (Hz)

CAL4.note: anchoring the operating luminal NaCl (~30 mM) and whole-kidney GFR (~120 mL/min) recovers the MD scale to within an order of magnitude; the model TGF half-max sits at 15 mM vs the cited ~30 mM (within 2x, reported not tuned); SGLT2i raises delivered NaCl (direction); the exact K_m and single-nephron GFR stay [O]
residual_open: absolute single-nephron GFR and the exact NKCC2 K_m (need micropuncture calibration)
CAL4.title: absolute macula-densa NaCl set + GFR scale

CAL5.note: the +20 mmHg MAP reset is a +20 mmHg SBP level shift (fixed pulse pressure), moving a normotensive ~115 mmHg SBP to ~135 mmHg = ACC/AHA stage-1 hypertension (>=130); the reset magnitude is clinically consistent, but the absolute incidence rate stays [O]
residual_open: absolute hypertension incidence rate (needs epidemiological cohort calibration)
CAL5.title: hypertension setpoint reset in clinical SBP (mmHg)

CAL6.note: the model renal-reference-reset durable drop (17 mmHg) matches the cited RDN office SBP (~-20 mmHg @3yr) within 15%; the sign of d(barrier margin) matches the sign of cited mortality in both HF arms (inotrope harm, four-pillar benefit); absolute HR/NNT stay [O]
residual_open: absolute clinical effect sizes (hazard ratios, NNT) -- the model has no event-time axis
CAL6.title: absolute therapy effect sizes (RDN dSBP; HF margin sign)

CAL7.note: the clinical organ-perfusion MAP floor (>=65 mmHg) anchors the RP8 vasoplegic floor, and the consensus orthostatic threshold (dSBP>=20 mmHg) matches the RP6 downward step that the autonomic-failure loop passes un-buffered; absolute shock incidence, per-taxon pressures, and the exact phylogenetic transition clade stay [O]
residual_open: absolute per-taxon arterial pressures and the exact phylogenetic transition clade (comparative physiology)
CAL7.title: perfusion-floor MAP + orthostatic threshold (mmHg)

ladder.note: transport by diffusion + body-wall contraction; NO pressure variable exists

hemolymph in a hemocoel; ostiate/tubular heart; low INCIDENTAL pressure; no closed loop, no arteriolar SVR effector, no renal pressure-natriuresis; PIEZO exists for proprioception but is not wired to a pressure reflex

true vessels and pressure, but a gill circuit in series drops systemic pressure; branchial baro-like reflexes give FAST (proportional) regulation; RAS present, but the full integral pressure-natriuresis loop is not yet the dominant defender
incomplete ventricular separation; baroreflex + RAAS maturing toward a defended setpoint
complete double circuit, high pressure; full baroreflex (carotid sinus + aortic arch) + full renal pressure-natriuresis (Guyton) -> the DEFENDED MAP modelled by this package

comparative.thesis: a defended arterial-pressure setpoint is EMERGENT: it appears only when a closed circuit, an arteriolar effector and a renal integrator co-exist on the same MAP = CVP + CO x SVR core. Lower organisms lack one or more legs, so pressure is incidental (open systems) or merely error-regulated (single-circuit fast reflex); the mammalian defended MAP is the top rung of loop accretion, not a different substrate

deferred: absolute scales now CALIBRATED [O]->[CAL] (CAL1-CAL7: pressure mmHg / baroreflex gain / firing Hz / macula-densa NaCl+GFR / hypertension reset in clinical SBP / therapy effect sizes / perfusion-floor+orthostatic) by explicit cited anchors -- first-principles derivation stays [O]; residual-open: absolute disease incidence, single-nephron GFR / NKCC2 K_m, trial HR/NNT, per-taxon pressures, the exact phylogenetic transition clade. No master-gene gamma remains to measure (REN [V]).
dynamics_status: EMERGED: sensory transduction + RP1-RP5 closed loops + interaction map + fundamental therapy read + hypotension node-decomposition (RP6-RP9) + cross-organism setpoint emergence + the comfort-logic intervention layer (analgesic three-lever technique, ported) all run deterministically under one hash.

RP6_orthostatic.anchor: autonomic failure / baroreflex loss -> orthostatic hypotension; mirror of the labile PIEZO1/2 double-KO (Zeng 2018) -- the buffer fails in BOTH directions [L]

RP7_adrenal_reference_loss.mirror: exact mirror of RP4: an integral controller defends a reset reference; here it is reset DOWN (lost RAAS/aldosterone reference). Fluids are opposed back; restoring the reference (mineralocorticoid) is durable -- the symmetric counterpart of antihypertensive durability

RP8_distributive_svr_collapse.failure_node: resistance effector (SVR), distinct from RP5 cardiac-output basin
RP8_distributive_svr_collapse.principle: distributive shock is an SVR-arm collapse -> the corrective is to restore SVR (vasopressor); raising CO alone cannot lift MAP above the perfusion floor [V]; norepinephrine first-line in septic shock [L]

RP9_hypovolemic_substrate_fold.asymmetry: renal natriuresis is excrete-only: a volume EXCESS self-corrects (RP3 perfect adaptation) but a volume DEFICIT cannot be self-corrected -- the kidney does not make blood. Hypovolemia is therefore a SUBSTRATE fold requiring external volume
RP9_hypovolemic_substrate_fold.failure_node: volume substrate (blood volume), distinct from reference (RP4/RP7) and effector (RP5/RP8)
RP9_hypovolemic_substrate_fold.principle: treat hypovolemic shock with VOLUME (transfusion/resuscitation), not vasopressor or inotrope alone [V]; the fast baroreflex (SVR/HR up) only buys time [L]

adrenal.fix: REPLACE the reference (mineralocorticoid); fluids alone are opposed back to the low reference -- mirror of antihypertensive durability (RP7)

cardiogenic.fix: TEMPORARY inotrope / mechanical support to hold perfusion -- opposite of chronic-HF inotrope harm, by timescale

distributive.fix: VASOPRESSOR to restore SVR (norepinephrine); inotrope/fluid alone cannot lift MAP above the perfusion floor (RP8)

hypovolemic.fix: VOLUME (transfusion/resuscitation); the kidney cannot replace a deficit (RP9); vasopressor only buys time

orthostatic_autonomic.fix: restore the buffer: volume expansion, compression, sympathomimetic / midodrine; not a reference change

T3_node_specific_therapy.principle: match the corrective to the FAILED NODE; the loop structure forbids a one-size pressor -- the wrong node's drug is rejected or insufficient

cardiogenic.timescale_distinction: chronic HF (T2): inotrope shrinks the barrier margin -> harm (PROMISE). acute cardiogenic shock: temporary inotrope / mechanical support is needed to maintain perfusion while the collapsed basin is recovered -- opposite sign by timescale, same R19 fold

hypotension.thesis: hypotension is not one disease but a NODE DECOMPOSITION of the defended-pressure loop: fast buffer (RP6), integrator reference (RP7), resistance effector (RP8), volume substrate (RP9), cardiac effector (cardiogenic). Each is computed on the SAME MAP = CVP + CO x SVR engine with the existing primitives -- a sharper test than the single hypertension reset.

RP3_pressure_natriuresis.model: renal integral controller dV/dt = intake - k(P - Pset)

organs.order_grade: [V] order is a gamma readout over MEASURED nodes; SIGN to validate vs cited timing

organs.role: pressure-natriuresis + RAAS volume control (the slow integrator)

baroreceptor.anchor: Zeng W-Z et al., 'PIEZOs mediate neuronal sensing of blood pressure and the baroreceptor reflex', Science 362:464-467 (2018); identity strong but contested (J Neurophysiol 122:13-15, 2019)

sglt2i.link: raised macula-densa NaCl delivery restores TGF and damps hyperfiltration -- a leading account of SGLT2i renal/CV benefit [L]

sensory.note: sensory cells transduce the regulated variables (PIEZO1/2 mechano; NKCC2 NaCl chemo); afferent firing is a shared-R19 spike train (see baroreceptor.substrate_spikes)
